decisions.reason: It sits far from the firm's maritime core, has only light public commitment on the website, and after two years without visible traction management has relatively little to justify by keeping it.
It builds directly on the firm's crewing capabilities, so management is likely to persist with it and explain any modest progress as temporary rather than abandon a related extension.
The branded Smart Academy has its own page, early partner growth, and a strong fit with the firm's training network, which makes continued commitment likely.
This service is close to the core offer, publicly highlighted with a concrete delivery success, and tied to the firm's stated move toward environmental and compliance support.
The dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software, indicating real investment and visible commitment, so management is unlikely to withdraw it quickly.
The simulation tool also builds on the core offer and is integrated into PAL, and despite limited reported results the sunk development effort and strategic relevance favor persistence.
